# INSIGHTS — summarized, verified findings (accumulate across the whole run)

The JOURNAL is your per-iteration diary; THIS file is the distilled, VERIFIED takeaway a future iteration should read instead of re-reading the whole journal or old sessions/traces. Update it whenever you have a genuinely NEW, confirmed finding (an accepted/rejected RESULT counts as confirmation; a guess does not) — not every iteration needs a new entry. Structure each addition as:

    ## <task or mechanism name>
    - What worked (confirmed by a RESULT, cite the candidate id):
    - What didn't (confirmed by a RESULT, cite the candidate id):
    - Promising but not yet tried:

## Payment handling on book_reservation (mechanism)
- Promising but not yet confirmed by a RESULT (shipped in cand_0001): the agent breaks book on two orthogonal payment problems — (1) malformed payment dicts (`id` instead of `payment_id`, missing `amount`), (2) a split that doesn't sum to total. Both are deterministically repairable in-body: normalize keys, and auto-correct when there is a single payment (it covers the total) or a single credit card (it absorbs the remainder after fixed-value gift cards/certificates).
- LATENT BUG worth remembering: book_reservation builds the Reservation with `payment_history=deepcopy(payment_methods)` BEFORE any later mutation of `payment_methods`. The graded DB hashes `reservation.payment_history`, NOT the tool return. So any correction applied to `payment_methods` after construction must be re-synced into `reservation.payment_history` or the DB keeps the stale amounts while the return looks correct. Verify fixes on the STORED reservation, not the return value.

## COMMUNICATE vs DB (mechanism)
- Tool RETURN values are not part of the DB hash, so enriching a write tool's return with an explicit `payment_summary`/`total_charged`/`total_refunded` string is DB-neutral and can only help the COMMUNICATE half (every communicate_info string must appear in some assistant message). Confirmed DB-neutral by inspection (serializer handles dict); reward impact pending a RESULT.

## Baggage free-allowance (mechanism)
- Promising (shipped cand_0001): mid model miscounts `nonfree_baggages` (passes the full bag count instead of subtracting the per-pax free allowance). The allowance is pure policy arithmetic (`{regular:0/1/2, silver:1/2/3, gold:2/3/4}[tier][cabin] × n_pax`), so recomputing nonfree in-body equals the gold value and is a no-op when the agent already got it right (verified no-op on passing task 12, fix on task 22). Pair it with a "charge only when total_price>0" guard so a within-allowance update is immune to a wrong/unneeded payment id.

## Reservation disambiguation is a real root cause (mechanism)
- Confirmed by trace inspection (not yet by a RESULT): Omar Rossi has multiple reservations;
  task 22 ALWAYS acts on UM3OG5 (SEA→DFW) when gold is FQ8APE (EWR→ORD = NY→Chicago). Task 17
  (same user, same gold) succeeds BECAUSE the agent enumerates all reservations and matches the
  route. So a correct baggage/flight fix is wasted if the agent is on the wrong reservation. The
  gold evaluation_criteria live in tau2 `data/tau2/domains/airline/tasks.json` under
  `evaluation_criteria.actions` + `.communicate_info` — extract these to get argument-level truth.

## Flaky losses are often NOT where the error message points (mechanism)
- task 25 reaches the correct final book (gift 128 + credit 247 = gold) via the "amount does not
  add up" error, yet still scores 0 in a trial — the real loss was wrong flight routing / a
  spurious transfer_to_human_agents at the end, not the payment split. Lesson: read the FULL
  trajectory tail (assistant messages + final tool calls), not just the first error, before
  deciding a payment guard will help.

## nonfree_baggages is fully derived, so recompute is safe (mechanism, verified against DB)
- `nonfree = max(0, total_baggages − allowance[membership][cabin] × n_pax)` with allowance
  regular{0,1,2}/silver{1,2,3}/gold{2,3,4} by {basic_economy,economy,business}. Recomputing it in
  update_reservation_baggages is policy-exact and a VERIFIED no-op on passing tasks 12 & 17 (both
  →0) while fixing task 22's nonfree=3→0; the paid-bags charge path (regular/econ total=3→nonfree
  2, $100) is preserved. Pair with "skip payment when total_price==0" so a free change can't be
  blocked by a wrong/unneeded payment id.
